osm_help_points_at9.title: OpenStreetMap help points inside the AT-9 box
osm_help_points_at9.endpoint_note: Public Overpass mirror. The canonical endpoints overpass-api.de, overpass.kumi.systems and overpass.private.coffee timed out from this build host on 2026-11-22; the mirror answered and is recorded as the actual endpoint used.
osm_help_points_at9.sanitized: Only element type/id, coordinates or way centre, and tags amenity, emergency and name. Contact, address, operator and payment tags are removed before the sample is committed.

bev_vienna_names.note: Derived by derive_bev_sample.py: five DLM name point tables, transformed to EPSG:4326 and filtered to the unpadded AT-9 box. The raw 58.5 MB GeoPackage is not committed.

not_downloaded: BEV DLM Bauwerke 2026-03-23 (about 2.6 GB): too large for a bounded prototype sample
BEV DLM Gewässer 2026-03-23 (about 396 MB): outside the minimum useful layer set
BEV address register 2026-10-01 (about 118.5 MB ZIP): address schema and four-digit postcodes need a separate decision
BEV ALS DTM / geoland terrain (1.9 GB to 7.6 GB per tile): outside a place-name and help-point prototype
Geofabrik Austria OSM extract: the bounded Overpass query replaces a whole-country extract
